tables.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.events_resolved_http AS SELECT *, canonical_user, if(startsWith(canonical_user, 'user:'), 'user', if(startsWith(canonical_user, 'anonymous:'), 'anonymous', '')) AS subject_kind, substring(canonical_user, length(subject_kind) + 2) AS subject_id FROM analytics.events_canonical ARRAY JOIN [if(user_id != '', concat('user:', user_id), joinGet('kansoku_context_cache', 'canonical_user', identity_context_key))] AS canonical_user WHERE (({scope_all_accounts:UInt8} = 1) OR (account_id = {scope_account:String})) AND (throwIf(joinGet('kansoku_identity_clock', 'deadline', toUInt8(0)) <= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(now64(3)), 'identity snapshot expired') = 0) AND (occurred_at >= {scope_from:DateTime64(3,'UTC')}) AND (occurred_at < {scope_to:DateTime64(3,'UTC')})
tables.name: events_resolved_http

tables.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.events_resolved_internal AS WITH candidates AS (SELECT * FROM analytics.events_canonical WHERE (({scope_all_accounts:UInt8} = 1) OR (account_id = {scope_account:String})) AND (occurred_at >= {scope_from:DateTime64(3, 'UTC')}) AND (occurred_at < {scope_to:DateTime64(3, 'UTC')})), candidate_signals AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT account_id, context_key, context_key.1 AS source_service, context_key.2 AS session_id, signal_kind, signal_value FROM analytics.identity_context_signals FINAL WHERE (({scope_all_accounts:UInt8} = 1) OR (account_id = {scope_account:String})) AND (day >= toDate({scope_from:DateTime64(3, 'UTC')})) AND (toDateTime64(day, 3, 'UTC') < {scope_to:DateTime64(3, 'UTC')})), bindings AS (SELECT account_id, signal_kind, signal_value, uniqExact(user_id) AS users, min(user_id) AS unique_user, multiIf((signal_kind IN ('email_hmac', 'email_sha256')), 0.95, signal_kind = 'cookie', 0.9, signal_kind = 'device', 0.8, signal_kind = 'fingerprint', 0.5, 0.) AS confidence FROM analytics.identity_signal_users WHERE (({scope_all_accounts:UInt8} = 1) OR (account_id = {scope_account:String})) AND ((account_id, signal_kind, signal_value) IN (SELECT account_id, signal_kind, signal_value FROM candidate_signals)) AND ((signal_kind != 'fingerprint') OR (observed_at >= (now64(3) - toIntervalDay(180)))) GROUP BY account_id, signal_kind, signal_value), session_users AS (SELECT account_id, source_service, session_id, signal_value, uniqExact(user_id) AS users, min(user_id) AS unique_user FROM analytics.identity_session_users WHERE (({scope_all_accounts:UInt8} = 1) OR (account_id = {scope_account:String})) AND ((account_id, source_service, session_id, signal_value) IN (SELECT account_id, source_service, session_id, signal_value FROM candidate_signals WHERE (signal_kind = 'cookie') AND (session_id != ''))) GROUP BY account_id, source_service, session_id, signal_value), matches AS (SELECT m.account_id AS account_id, m.context_key AS context_key, if((m.signal_kind = 'cookie') AND (s.users > 0), s.unique_user, b.unique_user) AS candidate_user, b.confidence AS confidence FROM candidate_signals AS m LEFT JOIN bindings AS b ON (b.account_id = m.account_id) AND (b.signal_kind = m.signal_kind) AND (b.signal_value = m.signal_value) LEFT JOIN session_users AS s ON (m.signal_kind = 'cookie') AND (s.account_id = m.account_id) AND (s.source_service = m.source_service) AND (s.session_id = m.session_id) AND (s.signal_value = m.signal_value) WHERE (if((m.signal_kind = 'cookie') AND (s.users > 0), s.users, b.users) = 1) AND (b.confidence >= 0.5)), best AS (SELECT account_id, context_key, groupArray(tuple(candidate_user, confidence)) AS hits, arrayMax(arrayMap(h -> (h.2), hits)) AS winning_confidence, arrayDistinct(arrayMap(h -> (h.1), arrayFilter(h -> ((h.2) = winning_confidence), hits))) AS winners, if(length(winners) = 1, winners[1], '') AS stitched_user FROM matches GROUP BY account_id, context_key), subjects AS (SELECT e.* EXCEPT account_id, e.account_id AS account_id, multiIf(e.user_id != '', 'user', m.stitched_user != '', 'user', e.anonymous_id != '', 'anonymous', '') AS subject_kind, multiIf(e.user_id != '', e.user_id, m.stitched_user != '', m.stitched_user, e.anonymous_id) AS subject_id FROM candidates AS e LEFT JOIN best AS m ON (m.account_id = e.account_id) AND (m.context_key = tuple(e.source_service, e.session_id, e.anonymous_id, e.identifiers))) SELECT *, if(subject_kind = '', '', concat(subject_kind, ':', subject_id)) AS canonical_user FROM subjects SETTINGS enable_materialized_cte = 1
tables.name: events_resolved_internal

tables.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.identity_context_resolution AS WITH (a, k, v) -> arrayDistinct(arrayMap(p -> (p.1), arrayFilter(p -> ((k != 'fingerprint') OR ((p.2) >= (now64(3) - toIntervalDay(180)))), joinGet('kansoku_signal_cache', 'observations', a, k, v)))) AS global_users, ((a, svc, sid, v) -> joinGet('kansoku_session_cache', 'users', a, svc, sid, v)) AS session_users, (k -> multiIf((k IN ('email_hmac', 'email_sha256')), 0.95, k = 'cookie', 0.9, k = 'device', 0.8, k = 'fingerprint', 0.5, 0.)) AS confidence, ((a, svc, sid, k, v) -> if((k = 'cookie') AND (sid != '') AND notEmpty(session_users(a, svc, sid, v)), session_users(a, svc, sid, v), global_users(a, k, v))) AS bound_users SELECT * EXCEPT (targets, best_confidence, winners), if(length(winners) = 1, winners[1], '') AS stitched_user FROM (SELECT *, arrayMax(arrayMap(h -> (h.2), targets)) AS best_confidence, arrayDistinct(arrayMap(h -> ((h.1)[1]), arrayFilter(h -> ((h.2) = best_confidence), targets))) AS winners FROM (SELECT *, arrayFilter(h -> ((length(h.1) = 1) AND ((h.2) >= 0.5)), arrayMap(sig -> tuple(bound_users(account_id, source_service, session_id, sig.1, sig.2), confidence(sig.1)), arrayDistinct(arrayFilter(sig -> ((sig.2) != ''), arrayConcat([('cookie', anonymous_id)], JSONExtractKeysAndValues(identifiers, 'String')))))) AS targets FROM (SELECT DISTINCT account_id, context_key.1 AS source_service, context_key.2 AS session_id, context_key.3 AS anonymous_id, context_key.4 AS identifiers FROM analytics.identity_context_signals FINAL WHERE (({scope_all_accounts:UInt8} = 1) OR (account_id = {scope_account:String})) AND (day >= {scope_from:Date}) AND (day < {scope_to:Date}))))
tables.name: identity_context_resolution

tables.name: mv_dau

tables.create_table_query: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW analytics.mv_experiment_exposures TO analytics.experiment_exposures (`account_id` String, `day` Date, `experiment` String, `variant` String, `users` AggregateFunction(uniqCombined, String)) AS SELECT account_id, toDate(occurred_at) AS day, CAST(toString(getSubcolumn(properties_json, 'experiment')), 'String') AS experiment, CAST(toString(getSubcolumn(properties_json, 'variant')), 'String') AS variant, uniqCombinedState(if(user_id != '', concat('user:', user_id), concat('anonymous:', anonymous_id))) AS users FROM (SELECT *, properties_json, identity_context_key, context_json FROM analytics.events_raw WHERE occurred_at >= (SELECT argMax(cutoff, revision) FROM analytics.retention_policy)) WHERE (event_name = 'experiment_viewed') AND ((user_id != '') OR (anonymous_id != '')) AND match(experiment, '^[a-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$') AND match(variant, '^[a-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$') GROUP BY account_id, experiment, variant, day
tables.name: mv_experiment_exposures

tables.create_table_query: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW analytics.mv_identity_context_signals TO analytics.identity_context_signals (`account_id` String, `day` Date, `context_key` Tuple(String, String, String, String), `signal_kind` String, `signal_value` String) AS SELECT account_id, toDate(occurred_at) AS day, tuple(source_service, session_id, anonymous_id, identifiers) AS context_key, sig.1 AS signal_kind, sig.2 AS signal_value FROM (SELECT *, properties_json, identity_context_key, context_json FROM analytics.events_raw WHERE occurred_at >= (SELECT argMax(cutoff, revision) FROM analytics.retention_policy)) ARRAY JOIN arrayDistinct(arrayFilter(kv -> ((kv.2) != ''), arrayConcat([('cookie', anonymous_id)], JSONExtractKeysAndValues(identifiers, 'String')))) AS sig WHERE user_id = ''
tables.name: mv_identity_context_signals

tables.create_table_query: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW analytics.mv_identity_signals TO analytics.identity_signals (`account_id` String, `signal_kind` String, `signal_value` String, `user_id` String, `observed_at` DateTime64(3, 'UTC'), `event_id` String, `received_at` DateTime64(3, 'UTC'), `source_service` String, `session_id` String) AS SELECT account_id, sig.1 AS signal_kind, sig.2 AS signal_value, user_id, occurred_at AS observed_at, event_id, received_at, source_service, session_id FROM (SELECT *, properties_json, identity_context_key, context_json FROM analytics.events_raw WHERE occurred_at >= (SELECT argMax(cutoff, revision) FROM analytics.retention_policy)) ARRAY JOIN arrayDistinct(arrayFilter(kv -> (((kv.1) != '') AND ((kv.2) != '')), arrayConcat([(if((event_name IN ('identify', 'identify_once', 'alias')), 'cookie', ''), anonymous_id)], JSONExtractKeysAndValues(identifiers, 'String')))) AS sig WHERE user_id != ''
tables.name: mv_identity_signals

tables.create_table_query: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW analytics.mv_organization_properties TO analytics.organization_properties (`account_id` String, `organization_id` String, `name` String, `value` AggregateFunction(argMax, Tuple(String, String, Float64), Tuple(DateTime64(3, 'UTC'), DateTime64(3, 'UTC'), String))) AS SELECT account_id, organization_id, name, argMaxState(tuple(trait_type, text_value, number_value), tuple(occurred_at, received_at, event_id)) AS value FROM (WITH toFloat64OrNull(toString(getSubcolumn(properties_json, 'seats'))) AS seat_number SELECT account_id, organization_id, event_id, occurred_at, received_at, trait.1 AS name, trait.2 AS trait_type, trait.3 AS text_value, trait.4 AS number_value FROM analytics.events_raw ARRAY JOIN [('plan', 'string', ifNull(dynamicElement(getSubcolumn(properties_json, 'plan'), 'String'), ''), toFloat64(0)), ('industry', 'string', ifNull(dynamicElement(getSubcolumn(properties_json, 'industry'), 'String'), ''), toFloat64(0)), ('country', 'string', ifNull(dynamicElement(getSubcolumn(properties_json, 'country'), 'String'), ''), toFloat64(0)), ('seats', 'number', '', ifNull(seat_number, toFloat64(0)))] AS trait WHERE (event_name = 'group') AND (schema_version = 2) AND (organization_id != '') AND governed_traits_valid AND ((account_id, event_id) NOT IN (SELECT account_id, event_id FROM
